$comment: Canonical Rapiddex deployment manifest for MST Mainnet. Front-ends and integrations should read addresses from this file instead of hardcoding them. Regenerate from deployment output; do not hand-edit. Each address was verified against on-chain runtime bytecode and by calling a distinguishing function.

WMSTC.name: Wrapped MSTC
WMSTC.verifiedBy: name() returns "Wrapped MSTC"; runtime bytecode is an exact match for src/WMSTC.sol

MUSDC.name: MUSD Coin
MUSDC.verifiedBy: name() returns "MUSD Coin"; decimals() returns 6; maxSupply() returns 1e15

MinimalPositionDescriptor.verifiedBy: tokenURI returns a decodable data:application/json;base64 payload

NonfungiblePositionManager.verifiedBy: factory() and WETH9() resolve to the canonical factory and WMSTC; ERC721 base is the pinned OpenZeppelin v3.4.2 submodule

SwapRouter.verifiedBy: factory() and WETH9() resolve to the canonical factory and WMSTC

QuoterV2.verifiedBy: factory() and WETH9() resolve to the canonical factory and WMSTC

build.evmVersionReason: MST Mainnet does not implement MCOPY. Raising this target produces contracts that deploy but revert on any function returning a dynamic string or bytes.
